Name: Zephaniah, Son of Maaseiah
Summary: Zephaniah, son of Maaseiah, was a priest — second priest at the fall — through whom Zedekiah repeatedly sent to Jeremiah, and to whom Shemaiah the Nehelamite wrote demanding Jeremiah's imprisonment. At Jerusalem's fall he was taken to Riblah and slain. He is a different man from Zephaniah the prophet.
KeyStory: Zedekiah sent Zephaniah the priest to ask Jeremiah to pray for the city, and after the fall Nebuzaradan took Zephaniah to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where he was slain.
RelatedPeople: Jeremiah; Zedekiah, King of Judah; Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Seraiah the Chief Priest
LifeLesson: Carrying messages between a king and a prophet is a dangerous middle place — and it ends where the city's sins end.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
